messages.content: Hello Sam. This optional exchange will help the team at Hotel Amour Nice prepare your stay from 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-13. We already have the reservation details shared with the team. You can skip a question or stop at any time. What would you like us to understand about this stay?
It's our anniversary, but we're really not into big romantic gestures.
Understood—an anniversary without the big romantic gestures. Would you enjoy a relaxed meal at the hotel’s Greek restaurant, or prefer to keep things unplanned?
A relaxed meal sounds good. My girlfriend and I hate being the centre of attention.
A relaxed meal with no spotlight on your anniversary—understood. Is there anything you particularly enjoy eating or prefer to avoid?
We like sharing little dishes, and neither of us drinks alcohol.

Sharing small dishes sounds well suited to the hotel’s Greek restaurant, and I’ll note alcohol-free drinks for both of you, with no public anniversary fuss. The team can check suitable options. Is there anything else you’d like to add or correct?
Thank you, Sam. Your preferences are noted for the team: a relaxed anniversary meal with small dishes to share, alcohol-free drinks for both of you, and no public fuss or big romantic gestures.

briefs.text:
A) BASIC INFO
Name: Sam — Short replies 03.
Party: Two; Sam and girlfriend.
Explicitly stated language: Unknown; exchange conducted in English.
Stay: 10–13 November 2026, Hotel Amour Nice.
Purpose / occasion: Anniversary stay; exact anniversary date Unknown.
Interaction style: Keep communication brief and discreet. Both dislike being the centre of attention and do not want big romantic gestures.

B) COORDINATION
Owner: Reception, as assigned handoff.
Reception to coordinate any optional meal proposal with the restaurant manager and alcohol-free drink choices with the bar.
Hotel DNA is public preparation material, checked 5 October 2026; operator review and operational confirmation remain pending. Confirm current service details before presenting arrangements as available.
No further preference interview is needed: Sam indicated there was nothing else to add.

C) GUEST PROFILE
What matters: A relaxed meal together, small dishes to share, and no public anniversary fuss.
Dietary / comfort constraints: Neither guest drinks alcohol. Allergies and other dietary requirements: Unknown; absence of disclosure is not confirmation of no allergies.
Requested personal note and placement: None.
Best outcome: An understated stay with the option of an easy sharing meal and suitable alcohol-free drinks, without ceremonial service or attention from other guests.
What already works: The guests welcomed the idea of a relaxed meal at the hotel’s Greek restaurant.
Watch outs: Do not add announcements, romantic decoration, surprise cake or other anniversary gestures. Do not infer preferences for sweetness, particular ingredients or a quiet room.
Experience suggestions: The restaurant’s Greek/Cypriot sharing preparations and the hotel’s published alcohol-free drink resources are relevant to the stated preferences; see F for a conditional proposal.

D) RECEPTION
Use a normal, discreet welcome; do not publicly highlight the anniversary.
If the guests wish to proceed with a meal, confirm their preferred timing and briefly check allergies or other dietary needs before passing requirements to the restaurant and bar.
Check the actual booked room and ordinary readiness; room category, arrival time and entitlements are Unknown. Do not imply early access or an upgrade.
Keep experience support with reception; a dedicated concierge is not established.

E) ROOM PREPARATION
Owner: Housekeeping through reception.
No special room setup, in-room food, drinks or personal note was requested. Use the normal preparation for the booked room; do not add anniversary decoration or romantic touches.
Room layout, bedding preferences and in-room service scope: Unknown. No special adaptation is indicated by the conversation.

F) RECEPTION — EXPERIENCE SUPPORT
Optional hotel meal composition:
The guests’ interest in sharing little dishes fits the restaurant’s published Greek/Cypriot cooking and sharing preparations. Reception may ask the restaurant manager to explore a small selection for two, served at a relaxed pace with no public anniversary acknowledgement. This is a proposed adjustment, not an existing package.
Restaurant manager and kitchen to confirm current dishes, portions, recipes, allergens and handling under their actual protocols, service timing, table suitability and cost. A patio table should not be assumed suitable or available in November; check weather and service arrangements.

Alcohol-free accompaniment:
Both guests avoid alcohol. The bar’s published resources include mocktails, juices, teas and coffee; offer a straightforward choice alongside the meal rather than inventing a bespoke welcome drink.
Bar to confirm genuinely alcohol-free recipes, current stock, hours, venue attribution of the linked drinks list and charges. Do not assume complimentary drinks, cross-venue stock or a preference for sweet or less-sweet options.

External research:
None indicated. The only stated experience interest is the hotel meal; do not add excursions, venues or a wider anniversary programme.
